title: Budgard
description: A calmer money app that turns budgets, bills and daily spending into one answer: what is safe to spend today. A free, installable PWA.
techStack: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Cron, Edge Functions)
features: A Today view that shows what is safe to spend after planned bills, with on-track status.
Log expenses and income with categories, tags, 23 currencies with live exchange rates, and compressed receipt photos.
Recurring expenses generated daily by Postgres cron, plus reusable templates.
Import CSV, OFX, QFX and QIF bank statements, with a review queue and merchant rules.
Monthly and per-category budgets with color-coded alerts, and a 50/30/20 needs, wants and savings ring.
Analytics with month-over-month comparison, category breakdowns, cash flow trends and spending insights.
Net worth tracking with account history, investment returns and savings goals.
Debt tracker with snowball and avalanche payoff plans.
Household sharing to manage shared finances without sharing logins.
Free core with Budgard Pro billing through Stripe checkout and customer portal.
Installable PWA with offline support, automatic sync and push notifications.
Passwordless email login, English and Greek, light, dark and Barbie themes.
